mapper.sql: a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.category_id, a.author_id, a.status, a.is_top, a.view_count, a.create_time, a.update_time, c.name AS category_name, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS author_name, u.avatar AS author_avatar
FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.author_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY a.view_count DESC, a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC
ORDER BY a.update_time DESC, a.id DESC
ORDER BY a.is_top DESC, a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT , ( (CASE WHEN a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 5 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM article_tag at5 INNER JOIN tag t5 ON t5.id = at5.tag_id WHERE at5.article_id = a.id AND t5.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) ) AS relevance
WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND ( a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM article_tag at6 INNER JOIN tag t6 ON t6.id = at6.tag_id WHERE at6.article_id = a.id AND t6.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) )
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC
ORDER BY relevance DESC, a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND ( a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM article_tag at6 INNER JOIN tag t6 ON t6.id = at6.tag_id WHERE at6.article_id = a.id AND t6.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) )

SELECT
WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND a.is_top = 1 ORDER BY a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , a.content
WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0
SELECT a.id, a.title FROM article a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND a.id < #{id} ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT a.id, a.title FROM article a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND a.id > #{id} ORDER BY a.id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT a.view_count FROM article a WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0

SELECT YEAR(a.create_time) AS stat_year, MONTH(a.create_time) AS stat_month, COUNT(*) AS stat_count FROM article a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 GROUP BY YEAR(a.create_time), MONTH(a.create_time) ORDER BY stat_year DESC, stat_month DESC
